audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sharp, natural sneezing sound from a female speaker, followed immediately by the kick-in of an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop track. The female voice begins a high-arousal narration in Mandarin, questioning her facial appearance with an energetic and friendly tone. The BGM features a steady four-on-the-floor kick drum and bright synth melodies. (2) As the narration transitions into product introduction, the BGM remains continuous. A distinct digital 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition. The speaker's voice is clear and professional, with frequent upward intonations to maintain engagement. Percussive 'pop' and 'click' sound effects are synchronized with the appearance of variety-style text on screen. (3) During the product demonstration, sharp digital 'ding' and 'UI click' sound effects occur every time a mode on the beauty device is changed or displayed. The ambient noise floor is extremely clean, indicating high-quality studio recording. The speaker describes specific modes (Lifting, Water-light) with high articulation and moderate speed. (4) The final section features a continuation of the upbeat BGM. A 'sparkle' sound effect accompanies shots of her glowing skin. The speaker’s arousal levels remain high as she announces a giveaway, ending the segment with a friendly closing remark while the music fades out quickly after the final word.

It uses a relatable 'morning puffiness' hook to introduce the device's lifting and skincare benefits, followed by a detailed tutorial and a giveaway offer to drive social media engagement.
